artists.biography: Sneaker Pimps are an English electronic music band, formed in Hartlepool in 1994. They are best known for their debut album, Becoming X (1996), and its singles "6 Underground" and "Spin Spin Sugar". The band's name is derived from an article the Beastie Boys published in their Grand Royal magazine about a man they hired to acquire classic sneakers.

perplexity.description:
Becoming X is the debut album by the English electronic band Sneaker Pimps, released on 19 August 1996 in the United Kingdom by Clean Up Records . The album is a defining work of the electronica and trip hop genres, seamlessly blending alternative rock and orchestral elements with layered samples to create a distinctive, moody sound . Its title derives from the fourth track, with vocalist Kelli Dayton explaining that "X" serves as a blank symbol representing "whatever you want it to mean," echoing the ambiguity of Generation X . The record features 11 tracks, including the iconic singles "6 Underground" and "Spin Spin Sugar," which helped establish the band's reputation and brought trip hop to a wider international audience .

The album achieved significant commercial success, reaching number 1 on the US Billboard Heatseekers chart and number 111 on the Billboard 200, while also earning a Gold certification from the BPI in the UK . Produced by a team including Jim Abbiss, Flood, and Peter Collins, the production showcases the band's ability to merge psych-rock, James Bond-inspired motifs, and hip-hop rhythms into a cohesive sonic identity . In 2016, the album was reissued on Clean Up Records to celebrate its twentieth anniversary, released as an 180-gram double vinyl with excellent audio quality at 45 RPM, reaffirming its status as a essential collection piece for trip hop enthusiasts .
